name: Zacks Data
description: Use Zacks Investment Research’s trusted data right in your AI chat — and give your AI assistant an edge. Zacks Connect AI is a Model Context Protocol (MCP) server that plugs the Zacks Rank, estimates, fundamentals, and market news straight into Claude, ChatGPT, Cursor, and other MCP-compatible agents.

_published_faq.name: How do I add Zacks Data to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor?

acceptedAnswer.text: Add Zacks Data to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor by connecting its remote MCP URL in each client's MCP settings. In Claude, add a custom connector. In ChatGPT, add an MCP app. In Cursor, add an MCP server under Settings. The MCP URL is https://mcp.zacksdata.com/. This server requires OAuth, so complete the login prompt after you connect.

_published_faq.name: What tools does the Zacks Data MCP server provide?

acceptedAnswer.text: Zacks Data provides these MCP tools: get_balance_sheet, get_cash_flow, get_company_snapshot, and get_income_statement.

_published_faq.name: What are the best alternatives to Zacks Data?

acceptedAnswer.text: As of October 18, 2026, alternatives to Zacks Data in financial-services on the Manufact MCP catalog include Contract-Factory — Sociétés & SIREN, Kavara Kirk, CeylonCharts, Netzo, and Ramp Data.

_published_faq.name: Does Zacks Data MCP require authentication?

acceptedAnswer.text: Zacks Data requires authentication. Connect it in Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor and complete the OAuth login prompt.
Zacks Data is developed by Zacks Investment Research. It is listed as partner on the Claude connector directory.
